verdict.rationale: LocalAI's first-party docs show it launching a local server (docker run -p 8080:8080, or local-ai run for Hugging Face and Ollama models) that exposes an OpenAI-compatible API at localhost:8080. Any OpenAI SDK or client can be pointed at it, and the repo ships a Swagger spec of the OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoints. The llms.txt and openapi.json probes returning 404 do not contradict this, because the spec is served at /swagger on the running server. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that the API works with any loaded model across all backends.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch a local OpenAI-compatible API server for any loaded model

citations.quote: LocalAI exposes an OpenAI-compatible API. You can use it with any OpenAI SDK or client by pointing it to http://localhost:8080.
One binary with an OpenAI-compatible API in front of it. Point an existing client at it and the calls keep working
covering the OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoints and LocalAI-specific surfaces
